Breadcrumb.description:
One thing the reporter did before they reported. A short timeline of these turns "it broke after I clicked save" into something reproducible.

Which fields are set depends on the kind: a click or a submit carries the `target` selector (and, for a click, the visible `text`), a navigation carries `from` and `to`, and a visibility change carries `to`.

from.description: Path and query the navigation left, or nothing when it is not known.

target.description: A short CSS selector for the element involved.

text.description: Visible text of the clicked element, whitespace-collapsed and clipped.

to.description: Path and query navigated to, or `hidden`/`visible` for a visibility change.

BugReport.description: The JSON body a report is sent as. Extra fields may be added by the client.

breadcrumbs.description: What the reporter did before reporting, oldest first.

elements.description: Elements the reporter pointed at, in the order they were attached.

network.description: Requests that failed or were slow before the report, oldest first.

ElementRef.description: An element the reporter pointed at: what it is, what it says, where it is.

attributes.description: id, name, role, type, href, aria-label, placeholder, title and data-* — never data-bugbottle*.

selector.description: A short CSS selector, e.g. `form#checkout > button:nth-of-type(2)`.

NetworkEntry.description:
One request the browser made before the report. Recorded by `bugbottle/network`, which keeps the failed and the slow ones.

Bodies and headers are never part of this, in either direction: that is where tokens and personal data live. What is left says which call failed and how long it took, which is the part that explains the report.

error.description: True when the request failed before a status — offline, CORS, aborted.

ms.description: How long the request took, in milliseconds.

status.description: The response status, or 0 when the request never got one.

ts.description: ISO 8601 timestamp of when the request finished.

url.description: Path and query, with sensitive query values redacted. Cross-origin URLs keep their origin.

ReportContext.description: Where the reporter was, and in what.

url.description: Path and query of the page. The origin and the fragment are left out.

description: The JSON body bugbottle POSTs to your endpoint. Generated from the BugReport type; the maxLength and maxItems ceilings are the ones the server-side validators enforce.
